Every completed day is punched out — and unlocks another batch of the live job feed.

Three shifts. One loop.

Teach → fulfill → sell, compressed into 14 days.

SHIFT A · DAYS 01–05
Skill Acquisition

The Copy-Work method: rebuild 3 real projects from scratch to build muscle memory, then a gap-fill micro-lesson on what's missing.

SHIFT B · DAYS 06–10
Mock Contract

Fulfill a real anonymized job brief under deadline + constraints — and package it as a case-study portfolio that doubles as your first proposal.

SHIFT C · DAYS 11–14
Send Proposals

Engineered proposals with "I see you need X…" hooks, a 5-proposal First-Bid challenge, and an auto-adapting iteration loop.

Your skill has a live job count. Prove it.

Earn a Demand-Validated badge with a live "N jobs open" counter — so clients can filter straight to freelancers who've recently completed this exact sprint.
